rag_scope_note: rag_first_byte_ms and rag_total_ms cover local-stub proxy overhead only (Plan 01-01 interpretation); live-Worker model latency is explicitly out of scope and deferred to a later plan.

route_ready_ms.rationale: Maximum observed DOMContentLoaded across four routes plus 2× measured run-to-run variability to account for browser/tooling overhead.

drawer_open_ms.rationale: Maximum drawer-open latency plus the full observed run-to-run range (59‑171ms).

node_expand_ms.rationale: Maximum node‑expand latency plus the full observed run‑to‑run range (58‑170ms).

chat_safe_error_ms.rationale: Maximum safe‑error round trip (server‑side 503 without upstream fetch) plus the full observed run‑to‑run range (150‑207ms).

rag_first_byte_ms.rationale: Maximum observed first response byte across grounded, abstention, and delayed‑250ms cases plus a 20‑ms chunk‑encoding headroom.

rag_total_ms.rationale: Maximum observed total completion across grounded, abstention, and delayed‑250ms cases plus 250‑ms headroom for queue/network jitter.

first_load_js_kb.rationale: Maximum per‑route first‑load JavaScript (parsed from build output) plus 50‑KB headroom for future library dependencies.

static_js_kb.rationale: Total static JavaScript bundle size (949 KB) plus 200‑KB headroom for future static assets.

static_css_kb.rationale: Total static CSS bundle size (26 KB) plus 20‑KB headroom.

lcp_ms.rationale: Maximum observed Lighthouse LCP across four routes (2630.1ms on /episodes) plus ~370ms headroom for run-to-run and machine variance.

fcp_ms.rationale: Maximum observed Lighthouse FCP across four routes (1845.3ms on /connections) plus ~355ms headroom for run-to-run and machine variance.
